content.title: Add caching layer to agt CLI for repeated list and view operations
content.description:
Repeated `agt list` and `agt view` calls read and parse the same JSON files from disk every time. Adding a lightweight in-process cache (or memoization) would speed up commands that are called frequently in quick succession — especially during triage, review, and automated flows.

**Context:** The CLI is used heavily in agent workflows where multiple `list` and `view` calls happen in rapid succession. Each call re-reads and re-parses the same files on disk.

**Suggested approach:** Consider an in-memory TTL-based cache keyed by file path + mtime, so stale data is invalidated when files change but hot reads are served instantly. Could be scoped per-command invocation or persisted via a lightweight cache file.
